analysis: Gp2b3A inhibitors are a class of antiplatelet drugs that inhibit the glycoprotein IIb/IIIa receptor on platelets, preventing aggregation. Abciximab, Eptifibatide, and Tirofiban are all Gp2b3A inhibitors. Prasugrel, however, is a thienopyridine that inhibits the P2Y12 ADP receptor and is not a Gp2b3A inhibitor.
